messages:
Alex Chen: FYI a national gov SQ arrived with heavy asks: per-tenant HSM-backed KMS (customer-managed), 365d append-only audit retention, EU-only residency proof, RBAC rule that blocks service accounts from decrypting tenant secrets, and SIEM/syslog ship. Need triage and a reply pack.
Maria Gonzalez: Ack. Do we have an on-prem HSM flow or a cloud-HSM-in-region option to describe? They also flagged 'no-export' for keys.
Tyler Kim: We support BYOK envelope flows for hosted and full CMK/HSM for Private. No-export can be satisfied if the KEK is provisioned to an in-region HSM with non-exportable key flags. Clarify whether they need on-customer-prem HSM or just gov-cloud HSM.
Eva Patel: For audit: we can provide signed append-only exports to customer buckets and a chain-hash for tamper evidence. Our default enterprise private retention can be set to 365d immutable via WORM on S3-compatible buckets; will validate exact proof steps.
Alex Chen: RBAC ask: they want an auditor role that can read audit but CANNOT decrypt, even indirectly. Also require service account roles that allow Encrypt/GenerateDataKey but deny Decrypt.
Tyler Kim: Draft IAM/role idea: 
- redwood.kms.encrypt-only: Allow GenerateDataKey, Encrypt; Deny Decrypt, ExportKeyMaterial
- redwood.kms.readonly-audit: Allow ReadAuditEvents, ListKeys; Deny Decrypt, GetKeyMaterial
- redwood.kms.full-admin: Allow all crypto ops
I'll put a policy snippet in the PR.
Maria Gonzalez: They want logs with request_id, tenant_id, model_id, route, principal, truncated prompt (first 128 chars) and redaction for PII. Can we show sanitized examples?
Eva Patel: Example syslog (sanitized) we can provide for SIEM: 
<14>1 2025-06-02T08:23:45Z redwood-gw host-2 - - audit: request_id=rdw-9f2 model=gpt-routes/v1 route=/v1/chat tenant=tenant-789 principal=svc:ingest prompt_prefix="Payment XXXX..." status=200 latency_ms=38
We also export structured JSON payloads for Splunk/ELK with field mapping.
sec-bot: CVE-2025-1234 patched in runtime v1.9.2; private images need hotfix. See internal: https://internal.redwood/sec/cve-2025-1234
Tyler Kim: Confirming images 1.9.2-patch rolling to private registry. For customers who can't patch immediately we can offer compensating controls: egress blocklist, IPS rules, and forbidding unapproved runtime images via KMS-enforced allowlist.
Alex Chen: Action items:
- Tyler: PR with IAM policy snippets + docs for encrypt-only and auditor roles by EOD (assign).
- Eva: sanitized syslog samples + retention verification steps by EOD.
- Maria: draft SQ answers for KMS custody, data residency, and schedule review call Wed 11:00 CET.
- Alex: loop legal for DPA/key-custody clause.
Maria Gonzalez: Also need an incident playbook for KMS outages and forensics asked by customer.
Eva Patel: Draft playbook (short):
1) Detect: KMS health probe alerts (>30s errors)
2) Failover: suspend key creation; route to cached-decrypt for warm keys; optionally fail to regional non-HSM model variant if customer approves
3) Evidence: snapshot signed-audit export to customer bucket + chain-hash; preserve request ids and token ids
4) Recovery: restore keys from standby KMS in-region or fail traffic to customer-managed standby KMS
5) Postmortem: provide signed bundle and timeline to customer
Tyler Kim: Note limitation: cached-decrypt only works for warm KV; cold keys can't be served without KMS. Will add to playbook.
Alex Chen: Also need attestation language for EU residency and non-exportable key material. Maria, get legal on the wording.
Maria Gonzalez: On it. I'll upload the draft answers and send the invite.
Tyler Kim: Draft policy snippet (example): 
{ "Version": "2023-10-01", "Statement": [ { "Effect": "Allow", "Action": ["kms:GenerateDataKey", "kms:Encrypt"], "Resource": "arn:redwood:kms:eu-1:tenant/789/*" }, { "Effect": "Deny", "Action": ["kms:Decrypt", "kms:ExportKeyMaterial"], "Resource": "arn:redwood:kms:eu-1:tenant/789/*" } ] }
PR #846 draft: https://git.internal/redwood/policies/pull/846
sec-bot: New advisory note: backport available for enterprise images; contact eng-infra for hotfix windows.
Alex Chen: Keep replies concise here, I'll consolidate into the SQ packet and send to the customer tomorrow. Post follow-ups in the PR or call notes channel. Thanks. :pray:
Maria Gonzalez: Meeting invite sent and draft uploaded to the shared drive.
Eva Patel: Uploading sanitized samples now: https://internal.redwood/share/gov-sq-samples
Tyler Kim: Comment on PR with deny logic if you see gaps: https://git.internal/redwood/policies/pull/846
